category_title: Non-verbal male students with classic autism who struggle with functional communication and use tactile tracing for letter recognition
scenario_title: Developing functional communication and social cues
minimal_context: The student is sitting in the classroom and is asked to communicate his snack preference using a traditional communication device.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for a snack. Please tell me what you want to eat using your Springboard Lite device.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Presses buttons on the screen randomly, not using his device as a functional use of communication to select a snack.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you want to eat?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes a vocal sound but exhibits difficulty using natural speech to answer the question.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to tell me what you need.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains unable to use natural speech to meet his daily communication needs and pushes the device away without communicating a choice.)

TUTOR: Try to tell me what you need.

STUDENT: (Remains unable to use natural speech to meet his daily communication needs and pushes the device away without communicating a choice.)
